name: academic_years
sql: CREATE TABLE academic_years (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   start_date TEXT,   end_date TEXT,   is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_active IN (0,1)),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: assignment_attachments
sql: CREATE TABLE assignment_attachments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(id),   r2_object_key TEXT NOT NULL,   file_name TEXT NOT NULL,   mime_type TEXT,   file_size_bytes INTEGER,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: assignment_submissions
sql: CREATE TABLE assignment_submissions (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(id),   student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   answer_text TEXT,   submitted_at TEXT,   marks_awarded REAL,   teacher_feedback TEXT,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','submitted','evaluated','late')),   UNIQUE(assignment_id, student_id) )

name: assignments
sql: CREATE TABLE assignments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   title TEXT NOT NULL,   instructions TEXT,   class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),   subject_id TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id),   batch_id TEXT REFERENCES batches(id),   teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   due_at TEXT,   max_marks REAL,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published' CHECK (status IN ('draft','published','closed')),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: audit_logs
sql: CREATE TABLE audit_logs (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   actor_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),   action TEXT NOT NULL,   entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,   entity_id TEXT,   details TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: batch_students
sql: CREATE TABLE batch_students (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches(id),   student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   enrolled_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','inactive','completed')),   UNIQUE(batch_id, student_id) )

name: batch_teachers
sql: CREATE TABLE batch_teachers (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches(id),   teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   UNIQUE(batch_id, teacher_id) )

name: batches
sql: CREATE TABLE batches (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   batch_name TEXT NOT NULL,   class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),   subject_id TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id),   academic_year_id TEXT REFERENCES academic_years(id),   batch_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (batch_type IN ('group','one_to_one')),   capacity INTEGER,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','inactive','completed')),   start_date TEXT,   end_date TEXT,   created_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: classes
sql: CREATE TABLE classes (     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,     class_name TEXT NOT NULL,     section TEXT,     academic_year TEXT NOT NULL,     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',     created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , curriculum_id TEXT REFERENCES curricula(id))

name: curricula
sql: CREATE TABLE curricula (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','inactive')),   sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: curriculam
sql: CREATE TABLE curriculam (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','inactive')),   sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: enquiries
sql: CREATE TABLE enquiries (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, parent_name TEXT, phone TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, student_class TEXT NOT NULL, board TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public_website', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (status IN ('new','contacted','demo_scheduled','enrolled','closed')), assigned_to TEXT REFERENCES users(id), follow_up_at TEXT, admin_notes TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

name: enquiry_history
sql: CREATE TABLE enquiry_history (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, enquiry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id), actor_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), action TEXT NOT NULL, old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT, notes TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

name: exam_attempts
sql: CREATE TABLE exam_attempts (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   exam_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams(id),   student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   submitted_at TEXT,   score REAL,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress' CHECK (status IN ('in_progress','submitted','evaluated','expired')),   UNIQUE(exam_id, student_id) )

name: exam_pathways
sql: CREATE TABLE exam_pathways (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','inactive')),   sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: exam_questions
sql: CREATE TABLE exam_questions (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   exam_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams(id),   question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id),   marks REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,   negative_marks REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   UNIQUE(exam_id, question_id) )

name: exams
sql: CREATE TABLE exams (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   title TEXT NOT NULL,   description TEXT,   class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),   subject_id TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id),   batch_id TEXT REFERENCES batches(id),   created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,   total_marks REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   pass_marks REAL,   starts_at TEXT,   ends_at TEXT,   shuffle_questions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (shuffle_questions IN (0,1)),   show_results_immediately INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (show_results_immediately IN (0,1)),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','scheduled','published','closed','archived')),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: fee_plans
sql: CREATE TABLE fee_plans (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   plan_name TEXT NOT NULL,   description TEXT,   amount_paise INTEGER NOT NULL,   billing_period TEXT,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: fee_receipts
sql: CREATE TABLE fee_receipts (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   fee_transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fee_transactions(id),   receipt_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   receipt_file_key TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: fee_transactions
sql: CREATE TABLE fee_transactions (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   fee_account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_fee_accounts(id),   amount_paise INTEGER NOT NULL,   payment_method TEXT,   transaction_reference TEXT,   payment_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: file_assets
sql: CREATE TABLE file_assets (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   owner_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),   file_name TEXT NOT NULL,   file_key TEXT NOT NULL,   content_type TEXT,   file_size INTEGER,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: live_class_attendance
sql: CREATE TABLE live_class_attendance (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   live_class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES live_classes(id),   student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   joined_at TEXT,   left_at TEXT,   attendance_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'present' CHECK (attendance_status IN ('present','late','absent','excused')),   marked_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),   UNIQUE(live_class_id, student_id) )

name: live_classes
sql: CREATE TABLE live_classes (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   title TEXT NOT NULL,   description TEXT,   batch_id TEXT REFERENCES batches(id),   teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),   subject_id TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id),   meeting_provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jitsi' CHECK (meeting_provider IN ('google_meet','jitsi','other')),   meeting_url TEXT NOT NULL,   starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,   ends_at TEXT NOT NULL,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (status IN ('scheduled','live','completed','cancelled')),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: notifications
sql: CREATE TABLE notifications (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   title TEXT NOT NULL,   message TEXT NOT NULL,   notification_type TEXT,   is_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: question_options
sql: CREATE TABLE question_options (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id),   option_label TEXT NOT NULL,   option_text TEXT NOT NULL,   is_correct INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_correct IN (0,1)),   sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 )

name: questions
sql: CREATE TABLE questions (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   subject_id TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id),   class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),   teacher_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),   topic TEXT,   difficulty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK (difficulty IN ('easy','medium','hard')),   question_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (question_type IN ('mcq','multiple_select','numerical','short_answer','long_answer')),   question_text TEXT NOT NULL,   explanation TEXT,   default_marks REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: results
sql: CREATE TABLE results (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES exam_attempts(id),   student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   exam_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams(id),   total_marks REAL NOT NULL,   marks_obtained REAL NOT NULL,   percentage REAL NOT NULL,   evaluated_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),   published_at TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: student_answers
sql: CREATE TABLE student_answers (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_attempts(id),   exam_question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_questions(id),   answer_text TEXT,   selected_option_ids TEXT,   is_correct INTEGER,   marks_awarded REAL,   answered_at TEXT,   UNIQUE(attempt_id, exam_question_id) )

name: student_fee_accounts
sql: CREATE TABLE student_fee_accounts (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   fee_plan_id TEXT REFERENCES fee_plans(id),   total_amount_paise INTEGER NOT NULL,   paid_amount_paise INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   due_date TEXT,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: student_profiles
sql: CREATE TABLE student_profiles (   user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),   admission_number TEXT UNIQUE,   date_of_birth TEXT,   guardian_name TEXT,   guardian_phone TEXT,   guardian_email TEXT,   address TEXT,   notes TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: study_materials
sql: CREATE TABLE study_materials (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   title TEXT NOT NULL,   description TEXT,   class_id TEXT REFERENCES classes(id),   subject_id TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id),   batch_id TEXT REFERENCES batches(id),   teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),   r2_object_key TEXT NOT NULL,   file_name TEXT NOT NULL,   mime_type TEXT,   file_size_bytes INTEGER,   visibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'assigned' CHECK (visibility IN ('assigned','all_students')),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),   deleted_at TEXT )

name: subjects
sql: CREATE TABLE subjects (     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,     subject_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',     created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

name: submission_attachments
sql: CREATE TABLE submission_attachments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   submission_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assignment_submissions(id),   r2_object_key TEXT NOT NULL,   file_name TEXT NOT NULL,   mime_type TEXT,   file_size_bytes INTEGER,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

name: teacher_assignments
sql: CREATE TABLE teacher_assignments (     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,     teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL,     class_id INTEGER NOT NULL,     subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL,     created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,     FOREIGN KEY (teacher_id) REFERENCES users(id),     FOREIGN KEY (class_id) REFERENCES classes(id),     FOREIGN KEY (subject_id) REFERENCES subjects(id),     UNIQUE (teacher_id, class_id, subject_id) )

name: users
sql: CREATE TABLE users (     id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,     full_name TEXT NOT NULL,     role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'teacher', 'student')),     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',     created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , email TEXT, deleted_at TEXT, deleted_by TEXT, phone TEXT, profile_photo_key TEXT)

name: exam_attachments
sql: CREATE TABLE exam_attachments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, exam_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams(id), uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), r2_object_key TEXT NOT NULL, file_name TEXT NOT NULL, mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, file_size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (file_size_bytes > 0 AND file_size_bytes <= 12582912), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

name: teacher_leaves
sql: CREATE TABLE teacher_leaves (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), leave_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal' CHECK (leave_type IN ('sick','personal','emergency','other')), start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled')), reviewed_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), reviewed_at TEXT, review_note TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), CHECK (end_date >= start_date))

name: teacher_coverage_assignments
sql: CREATE TABLE teacher_coverage_assignments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, leave_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher_leaves(id), scope_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_type IN ('batch','class_subject')), batch_id TEXT REFERENCES batches(id), class_id INTEGER REFERENCES classes(id), subject_id INTEGER REFERENCES subjects(id), primary_teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), substitute_teacher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), effective_from TEXT NOT NULL, effective_to TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','cancelled','completed')), created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), CHECK (effective_to >= effective_from), CHECK ((scope_type='batch' AND batch_id IS NOT NULL AND class_id IS NULL AND subject_id IS NULL) OR (scope_type='class_subject' AND batch_id IS NULL AND class_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (primary_teacher_id <> substitute_teacher_id))

name: student_class_entitlements
sql: CREATE TABLE student_class_entitlements (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches(id), subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), total_classes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_classes > 0), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','inactive')), created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), UNIQUE(student_id,batch_id,subject_id))

name: student_badge_definitions
sql: CREATE TABLE student_badge_definitions (badge_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, badge_name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, threshold_percent INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (threshold_percent IN (25,50,75,100)), badge_emoji TEXT NOT NULL, sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: student_badges
sql: CREATE TABLE student_badges (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches(id), subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id), badge_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_badge_definitions(badge_code), earned_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, earned_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), UNIQUE(student_id,batch_id,subject_id,badge_code))

name: student_class_progress
sql: CREATE VIEW student_class_progress AS SELECT e.student_id,e.batch_id,e.subject_id,e.total_classes,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lc.status='completed' AND lca.attendance_status IN ('present','late') THEN lc.id END) completed_classes,MIN(100,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lc.status='completed' AND lca.attendance_status IN ('present','late') THEN lc.id END)*100.0/e.total_classes AS INTEGER)) completion_percent FROM student_class_entitlements e LEFT JOIN live_classes lc ON lc.batch_id=e.batch_id AND (lc.subject_id=e.subject_id OR lc.subject_id IS NULL) AND lc.status='completed' LEFT JOIN live_class_attendance lca ON lca.live_class_id=lc.id AND lca.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.status='active' GROUP BY e.student_id,e.batch_id,e.subject_id,e.total_classes
